kids_evidence: Not a children's app. Spec user: 'a DIY renovator, a handyperson, a tiler, or a renter putting up shelves' (iMeasure.md:50). store/apps/iMeasure.json primary_category = UTILITIES. store/ratings/iMeasure.json has no kids field and advertising: true (:16).

banner.where: lib/screens/home_shell.dart:131-132 (BannerAdSlot, own widget lib/widgets/banner_ad_slot.dart, shown only on the Instruments and Jobs tabs: home_shell.dart:26)

interstitial.why: This is the app's own AdService, not agl_ads. Every 3rd instrument the user closes shows an interstitial: lib/screens/instruments_screen.dart:161 AdService.instance.onToolClosed(); lib/services/ad_service.dart:171-200; lib/services/ads_config.dart:154 interstitialEveryNTools = 3. iMeasure is a utility opened repeatedly in quick, task-focused sessions. Its own comment says 'utility tools people open repeatedly in a single session' (ads_config.dart:151-153).

native.why: No content feed. The lists are the user's own jobs (lib/screens/jobs_screen.dart:80-104) and a job's readings (JobDetailScreen, lib/screens/jobs_screen.dart:396-406, for-loop at :401 inside an inset GroupedList, next to CSV export). These are working measurement records in an iOS-style grouped list. An ad row would break the grouping and sit inside a professional record. I am not sure it fits, so use=false.

rewarded.why: Nothing honest to reward. There is no quota and no paid tier ('There is no paid tier' at lib/services/ad_service.dart:36). CSV and photo export (lib/screens/jobs_screen.dart:213-233, lib/screens/settings_screen.dart:170-175) is part of the core job and must not be gated.

blockers: Move onto agl_ads: replace AdService and BannerAdSlot (google_mobile_ads ^9.1.0 used directly, pubspec.yaml:67) with AglAds.configure/initialize and AglAdBanner on the Jobs and Instruments tabs. Delete the interstitial path (ad_service.dart:127-200, instruments_screen.dart:161, ads_config.dart:154). Today agl_ads supplies only AglConsent (ad_service.dart:81, :85, :107, :134).
